notes.title: Year-One Aniversary Event !
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31940133/e2c5c1c4df04415ed398e2274530322125ec1fe2.png[/img]
Looks like it was yesterday that Lonely in the Winter went into steam, but it was not. However I as indie developer throughout this year, received several feedbacks and the common point in all of them, even the negatives (:sadface:), was that the game ended very fast.

That's why I decided to expand the game with a new area! In it there is the Guardian of the crystal and you will probably want his permission to be able to leave the island with the crystal in peace! I believe you will like the challenge because it will not be so easy to get to the Guardian.

Show that you are capable of this! There was released two more achievements and one of them is to reach the rank SS !

Ready, Set ..... GO !

notes.title: Fullscreen
notes.content:
In this update

* Bug fixes.

* Fullscreen suport.
   - In Options you can turn On/Off Fullscreen.

* Exit button.

notes.title: Minigame Skip
notes.content:
Hey guys SoyeR here !

  Since december i try to fix the FPS on the Snowball minigame and with no sucess. Mostly Pc's run the minigame acceptable but not perfect, but in others is terrible like 2~4 fps. BECAUSE that i made a skip option for those who can't play the minigame but wants to finish the game.

I will keep trying fix that !

and Russian translate still in progress ! 
Need some help in revision !

if anyone is interested contact me in this email: araplay@outlook.com

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content:
Bugs fixed:

* Some areas of the cave could be walked along the wall.
* "Press X for Menu" did not disappear.
* Walking diagonally skips some scenes.

In progress:

Russian Translation.

notes.title: Launch Challenge !
notes.content:
Taking advantage that no one still managed to achieve the achievement 
RANK S, we are bringing an event where the top 10 to get RANK S will be immortalized on our website and our social media!

To participate take a Print of the scoring screen and send it to the email
"araplay@outlook.com" with the title "Rank S" with the print attached and the link of your profile in the steam and the name you want to appear in the rank.

We will add the names as they are submitted. the deadline ends on March 2.

Good Luck !!

Website: [url=http://araplay.webnode.com/lonely-in-the-winter/] Lonely in the winter[/url]
